name: kllm-bench-qrels
description: kllm-bench-qrels provides relevance judgments (qrels) intended for evaluating retrieval and ranking components in KLLM-style benchmarks. It enables standardized relevance evaluation of candidate documents against queries, supporting evaluation of retrieval-augmented language models and ranking systems. The qrels are intended to be used with standard IR metrics to compare retrieval effectiveness across systems.
reputation: A technical resource for IR-style evaluation in the KLLM community; used primarily by researchers working on retrieval-augmented LLMs and ranking evaluation.
